title: Data and code for mobility-informed ozone exposure assessment across 33 Chinese cities
description: Data and code for mobility-informed ambient ozone exposure assessment across 33 Chinese cities. The frozen analysis pairs residential-anchor and mobility-informed estimates across 153 common dates in May–September 2019. Repository: https://github.com/Weiwei-Hao/mobility-informed-ozone-exposure. Creator: Weiwei Hao, Anyang Institute of Technology. Original code is licensed under MIT; original study-derived data and author-generated metadata are CC BY 4.0. The attributed real-input subset retains WorldMove v1 and ChinaHighO3 2019 v1 source CC BY 4.0 terms; source attribution and transformations are documented. Schedules are synthetic and ozone concentrations are modelled. Complete upstream products, external GIS layers, artwork and manuscript files are excluded. Supplied-data core models and LOCO were validated before release; the complete national-input chain and all sensitivity/ML refits were not rerun during publication.
